arguments.value: Adrienne Camille Nelson, born in 1967 in Kansas City, Missouri, is a Judge of the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon. She received a B.A. from the University of Arkansas in 1989 and a J.D. from the University of Texas School of Law in 1993. Her career includes work as an attorney with Multnomah Defenders, Inc. in Portland, Oregon, private practice in Portland, an adjunct professorship at Lewis & Clark Law School, and service as coordinator and senior attorney at Portland State University. She served as a judge on the Oregon Circuit Court for Multnomah County from 2006 to 2018 and as a justice of the Supreme Court of Oregon from 2018 to 2023 before her federal appointment.
